insights.summary: The agent successfully implemented a performance-related configuration change that follows the spirit of the human reference commit. It showed strong repository navigation skills and a systematic approach to problem-solving despite the base code differing from the provided example.
strengths: Excellent use of git history to understand context.
Strong ability to generalize an optimization pattern.
weaknesses: Did not investigate the MoE kernels specifically suggested in the prompt.
Verification was limited to config state rather than runtime performance metrics.
